jobs.title: Biology Instructor
jobs.description: POSITION: BIOLOGY INSTRUCTOR POSITION DESCRIPTION: Under supervision of Associate Dean of Science and Dean of Arts and Sciences, performs all aspects of instruction for academic Biology courses; develops course syllabi, goals, and objectives; evaluates students’ progress in attaining goals and objectives. Prepares and maintains all required documentation and administrative reports; attends staff development training, workshops, seminars and conferences; assists in academic support services, including advisement and tutoring. Performs and/or supervises lab set up/take down and ensures lab safety requirements are followed; submits lab equipment and supply orders. Serves on college committees, participates in community service activities, and/or participates in college initiatives; meets with students, staff members, and other educators to discuss students’ instructional programs and other issues; assists with recruitment, retention and job placement efforts; could be required to provide instruction on multiple campuses. Employment is with Chattahoochee Technical College and not with an individual campus. All employees are subject to work relocation based on college needs. Although no position is specific to an individual campus, this position will require the individual to provide instruction on multiple campuses. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: · Educational Level: A Master’s degree in Biology from a regionally accredited four-year college or university with a minimum of 18 graduate semester hours in Biology coursework. · Three years paid teaching experience, preferably in a fulltime position. Excellent written and oral communications skills along with excellent computer skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: (In addition to the minimum qualifications) · PhD degree in Biology. Graduate hours in Microbiology, Anatomy & Physiology. Additional eighteen graduate semester hours in chemistry. Postsecondary teaching experience with computer-assisted instruction, instructional technology, and student advisement/registration. SALARY/BENEFITS: Salary $62,972 annually. Benefits include: paid holidays, annual leave, and the State of Georgia Flexible Benefits Program. Please be aware that all Chattahoochee Technical College employees must be paid by DIRECT DEPOSIT unless exempted by the State Accounting Office based on “hardship” evidence provided by the employee. Before a candidate is hired, a pre-employment criminal background investigation, motor vehicle records check and employer/professional reference check will be conducted. RESPONSE DEADLINE: Open until filled. Screening will begin immediately. ANTICIPATED HIRE DATE: May 2026 EMPLOYMENT POLICY: Chattahoochee Technical College is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges to award associate degrees. jobs.description: POSITION: Dental Hygiene Instructor, Full-Time Position, Vidalia campus DESCRIPTION: Under general supervision, the instructor will provide effective instruction to students in classroom and laboratory settings. The instructor must demonstrate the ability to teach all components of the curriculum, utilizing appropriate teaching techniques and assessment methods. Additionally, the instructor will maintain accurate records, participate in professional development, and collaborate with students and college personnel to support student success. The work hours for this position are scheduled Monday through Thursday, 10 hours per day. Key Responsibilities: • Deliver instruction in accordance with approved course syllabi, including classroom and laboratory formats. • Prepare and update syllabi, lesson plans, and instructional materials. • Develop and implement program goals and student learning objectives. • Evaluate and monitor student progress, providing feedback and support to facilitate achievement. • Employ appropriate teaching methods, testing, and grading procedures, including maintaining accurate grade books and records. • Communicate effectively through oral and written means with students and college staff. • Stay current with industry procedures and best practices. • Complete all required reports, records, and invoices promptly. • Maintain an accurate inventory of assigned equipment and materials. • Attend and complete all required professional development activities. • Meet with students and college personnel to discuss instructional programs and student progress. • Adhere to all institutional policies, procedures, and standards set by the Technical College System of Georgia (TCSG) and accreditation agencies. • Travel as needed for meetings or instructional purposes. Qualifications: • Valid teaching credentials as required by the TCSG Policy Manual. • Demonstrated ability to teach all aspects of the curriculum. • Strong organizational, communication, and recordkeeping skills. • Commitment to ongoing professional development. • Ability to adapt to various instructional settings, including traditional, online, and clinical environments. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: • Baccalaureate degree • Registered Dental Hygienist. Applicants must have an active Georgia Dental Hygiene License in good standing with the Georgia Board of Dentistry • Current Basic Life Support CPR Certification • At least three years of recent employment as a dental hygienist • Current continuing education • Excellent interpersonal skills and work ethics • Efficient computer and technology skills PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: • Bachelor of Science degree in dental hygiene from a program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation • Continuing education in all dental hygiene subjects • Current certification in administering Local Anesthesia • Prior experience teaching in a dental hygiene program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation • Prior instructional experience in the post-secondary educational setting including knowledge of educational methodology techniques, proficiency in preparation and delivery of instruction, curriculum design, and teaching using standards of educational and professional practice SALARY/BENEFITS: Salary is to be commensurate with education and work experience.
